# moddotplot-rs v0.4.0

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.4.0 hardens browser orchestration and cross-layer resource accounting. It remains a
functional preview and does not change schema-1 scientific output.

## Owned work

The compute worker now represents loaded data, comparisons, and sequence-derived
feature calculations as separate owned jobs. Each has an immutable identifier and
abort signal. Comparisons own their scientific configurations, published-tile keys,
refinement priorities, and presentation wait. Publication is permitted only by the
current matching job.

Dataset lifetime is deliberately distinct from comparison generation: one loaded
dataset can serve successive comparisons, while replacing or clearing that dataset
cancels all dependent work. Annotation parsing has the same cooperative cancellation
property and cannot publish a completion or error after cancellation.

## Operational scaling

The browser now accounts for a 3 GiB Wasm limit, 96 MiB each for JavaScript tiles and
GPU textures, 512 MiB for imported annotations, 64 MiB for computed tracks, 256 MiB
for transient publication, and a 4 GiB combined plan. Each over-budget class has a
declared eviction, downgrade, sharding, or rejection fallback with a user-facing
reason.

FASTA transfer uses bounded 4 MiB shards and progressive axis work uses bounded bin
shards. OPFS spill is not enabled: current evidence does not justify its additional
failure surface. Robust one-billion-base operation on ordinary laptops remains a
conditional claim pending broader measurements.

The generated one-million-record annotation case measured 176,000,000 retained bytes
and 1.40 seconds including structured publication cloning. Both fit the accepted
envelope, so this release does not replace the existing graph with a new compact format.

See the [validation record](v0.4.0/VALIDATION.md) for complete local evidence.
